additional_info.subject: ID0424127-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/RD 300000004029] Internal EVSE temperature exceeded lower limit CRM:02699000091
additional_info.body:
Hi Furkan! Eventually I got the ticket :D
I saw the logs you sent me and I see the values being very high. Please check if the connections are done properly inside the charger:
My recommendation always is to reconect these XD9.2 and XD10.1 as they can become loose easily and might be transmitting a bad value.
Second thing is to compare the value by removing the cables from the KF's are measuring resistance between the cables (we need to remove them from the cartridge in order to isolate them), they should have the value that you see on the logs.
If the values are all correct, then can you please check if the filters are not clogged? I see that the temperature is very high for all BTs so I wouldn't assume to be an isolated issue.
How are the conditions on this charger? Is it exposed directly to sun and the weather there is hot? This could also be a consequence.
I will send this ticket back to you and please talk to me via Teams if you need any help or have any questions.
Take spare BTs to site in case it needs replacement.
Best regards,
Francisco
